comments: "UfiSpace S9600-72XC open aggregation router - 2RU disaggregated white box on Broadcom Qumran2c\
  \ with an optional external OP2 TCAM (premium SKU), 2.4 Tbps and 4 GB of deep buffer, carrying 64x 1/10/25G\
  \ SFP28 in four ganged blocks and 8x 40/100G QSFP28, plus 2x 10G SFP+ management ports and a timing\
  \ block (GNSS on SMA, 1PPS and 10MHz on SMB, ToD on RJ45, Stratum 3E OCXO, SyncE, 1588v2 Class C and\
  \ TSN); four hot-swap fans (3+1) and dual 1300W supplies (1+1) at the rear. Built for 5G C-RAN fronthaul\
  \ aggregation, BBU-pooling backhaul and BNG\n\nConfiguration `base`: The router as HIG Figure 4 draws\
  \ it - four FAN-803816-HI exhaust fans and two 1300 W AC supplies at the rear, and the seventy-two traffic\
  \ ports empty. No orderable chassis part number appears in any held document; see the chassis-sku gap.\n\
  \nDatasheet: UfiSpace S9600-72XC 25G/100G Open Aggregation Router Datasheet\n  https://www.ufispace.com/products/telco/aggregation/s9600-72xc-25g-100g-open-aggregation-router-tcam\n\
  \nFacts carried in the model that this schema has no field for:\n- compliance.emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart\
  \ B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386;\
  \ EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; MTCTE; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A\n- compliance.environment: ETSI 300 019;\
  \ ETSI 300 132-2; RoHS; WEEE; MTCTE\n- compliance.nebs: NEBS GR-1089, GR-3108 (EMC); NEBS GR-63 (environment)\n\
  - compliance.safety: UL 62368-1; IEC 60950-1; IEC 62368-1; BSMI\n- environmental.operating-humidity:\
  \ 5 to 85% RH non-condensing\n- environmental.operating-temp: 0 to 45 C\n- environmental.storage-humidity:\
  \ 5 to 93% RH non-condensing\n- environmental.storage-temp: -40 to 70 C\n- features.gnss: internal receiver\
  \ for master clock implementations\n- features.optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR4/LR4/ER4/ZR4, up to 80\
  \ km per the HIG port table\n- features.optics-sfp-plus: 10G on the two SFP+ management ports. The datasheet's\
  \ Compatible Transceiver Types list is one list for the whole box and names no management-only part,\
  \ so the speed here is the port list's ('2 x 10G SFP+ management ports')\n- features.optics-sfp28: 25G\
  \ SFP28 SR/LR/ER; 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER; 1G SFP SX/LX/EX - the same cages take all three speeds, and the\
  \ HIG's port table rates ports 0-63 to 40 km\n- features.roles: C-RAN hub 5G fronthaul transport aggregation;\
  \ backhaul aggregation for BBU pooling; programmable as a Broadband Network Gateway (BNG)\n- features.routing:\
  \ full Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6)\n- features.timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover;\
  \ SyncE (ITU-T); IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (additional licence),\
  \ T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC; Time Sensitive Networking (TSN); Class C timing accuracy. NOS integration is\
  \ required to activate these, which the datasheet states with an asterisk against the whole timing block.\
  \ The datasheet's introduction separately states IEEE 802.1CM fronthaul and ITU-T G.8273.2 T-BC Class\
  \ C\n- features.timing-cables: the datasheet's Compatible Timing Cable Types row - 50 ohm SMA coaxial\
  \ with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and\
  \ 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD. The accessory kit ships two SMB-to-BNC converter cables\n- features.timing-interfaces:\
  \ GNSS SMA in; 1PPS SMB in/out; 10MHz SMB in/out; ToD RJ45 in/out\n- lifecycle.eol: none-announced\n\
  - management.console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console\n- management.oob: 1x RJ45 100/1000M\
  \ management port\n- performance.packet-buffer: 4 GB deep buffer\n- performance.switching-capacity:\

  \ port and the RJ45 and micro-USB console pair, both lettered IOIOI. Four hot-swap fans (3+1) and dual\
